```{r, Prepare data}

library(openxlsx)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(sjPlot)
library(knitr)
library(estimatr)
library(car)
library(sandwich)
library(gee)
library(rstatix)
library(psych)
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(emmeans)
library(xtable)
library(Superpower)
library(pwranova)
library(EnvStats)

# Load in the data set for blame graphs
df_long <- read.xlsx("Victim Blame S1-3 LONG 2026.11.11.xlsx")
df_wide <- read.xlsx("Victim Blame S1-3 WIDE 2026.11.11.xlsx")

df_long$polGen <- as.factor(df_long$polGen)
df_long$session <- as.factor(df_long$session)

df_wide$polGen <- as.factor(df_wide$polGen)
df_wide$session <- as.factor(df_wide$session)

# Rename variables

# Target
df_long$Target <- ifelse(df_long$VictVsPerp == 0, "Victim", "Perpetrator")
df_long$Target <- factor(df_long$Target, levels = c("Perpetrator", "Victim"))

table(df_long$VictVsPerp)
table(df_long$Target)

# Sex
df_long$Sex <- ifelse(df_long$sexBin == 0, "Female", 
                      ifelse(df_long$sexBin == 1, "Male", df_long$sexBin))
df_long$Sex <- factor(df_long$Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))

df_wide$Sex <- ifelse(df_wide$sexBin == 0, "Female", 
                      ifelse(df_wide$sexBin == 1, "Male", df_wide$sexBin))
df_wide$Sex <- factor(df_wide$Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))

table(df_wide$sexBin)
table(df_wide$Sex)

# Ideology
df_long$Ideology <- ifelse(df_long$polGen == 0, "Liberal",
                           ifelse(df_long$polGen == 1, "Moderate", 
                           ifelse(df_long$polGen == 2, "Conservative", df_long$polGen)))

df_long$Ideology <- factor(df_long$Ideology, levels = c("Liberal", "Moderate", "Conservative"))

df_wide$Ideology <- ifelse(df_wide$polGen == 0, "Liberal",
                           ifelse(df_wide$polGen == 1, "Moderate", 
                           ifelse(df_wide$polGen == 2, "Conservative", df_wide$polGen)))

df_wide$Ideology <- factor(df_wide$Ideology, levels = c("Liberal", "Moderate", "Conservative"))

table(df_wide$polGen)
table(df_wide$Ideology)

# Session
df_long$Wave <- ifelse(df_long$session == 0, "Wave 1", 
                          ifelse(df_long$session == 1, "Wave 2", "Wave 3"))
df_long$Wave <- factor(df_long$Wave, levels = c("Wave 1", "Wave 2", "Wave 3"))

df_wide$Wave <- ifelse(df_wide$session == 0, "Wave 1", 
                          ifelse(df_wide$session == 1, "Wave 2", "Wave 3"))
df_wide$Wave <- factor(df_wide$Wave, levels = c("Wave 1", "Wave 2", "Wave 3"))

table(df_wide$Wave)
table(df_wide$session)

# Threat
df_wide$Threat <- df_wide$fear
```

```{r, Balance checks}

# Make sure demos balanced across wave
# Age, religiosity, sex, ideology, and sexual orientation

# Continuous variables 

# Age
summary(aov(Age ~ session, data = df_wide))
# p = .524

# Religiosity 
summary(aov(relPrac ~ session, data = df_wide))
# p = .056

##

# Categorical variables (sex, ideology, sexual orientation)

# Sex
chisq.test(table(df_wide$sexBin, df_wide$session))
# p = .645

# Ideology
chisq.test(table(df_wide$polGen, df_wide$session))
# p = .436

# Sexual orientation
chisq.test(table(df_wide$sexOrien_Bin, df_wide$session))
# p = .024 - sig. Maybe because cell sizes small for non-straight

# Check if driven by small amount of non-straight people
prop.table(table(df_wide$session, df_wide$sexOrien_Bin), margin = 1) # Proportions within each session (so row add up to 1)

# Yes
# Wave 1 - 20%
# Wave 2 - 13%
# Wave 3 - 15%

# Pairwise comparisons of proportion

# Create matrix
sex_orient_tab <- table(df_wide$session, df_wide$sexOrien_Bin)
sex_orient_tab

# Test
pairwise.prop.test(x = sex_orient_tab, p.adjust.method = "none")
# Wave 1 differs from Wave 2

```

```{r, Table for balance checks}

# Create table with age, religiosity, sex, ideology, and sexual orientation at each wave
demos_wave_table <- df_wide %>%
  group_by(Wave) %>%
  summarize(
    Age = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                  mean(Age, na.rm = T),
                  sd_age = sd(Age, na.rm = T)),
    Religiosity = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                          mean(relPrac, na.rm = T),
                          sd(relPrac, na.rm = T)),
    'Male (vs. Female)' = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                          mean(sexBin, na.rm = T),
                          sd(sexBin, na.rm = T)),
    'Moderate (vs. Liberal)' = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                          mean(as.numeric(pgen_dc1), na.rm = T),
                          sd(as.numeric(pgen_dc1), na.rm = T)),
    'Conservative (vs. Liberal)' = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                          mean(as.numeric(pgen_dc2), na.rm = T),
                          sd(as.numeric(pgen_dc2), na.rm = T)),
    'Straight (vs. Non-Straight)' = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                         mean(as.numeric(sexOrien_Bin), na.rm = T),
                         sd(as.numeric(sexOrien_Bin), na.rm = T)),
    .groups = "drop"
    
    )

demos_wave_table

# Swap rows and columns
demos_wave_table_transposed <- as.data.frame(t(demos_wave_table[-1]))
demos_wave_table_transposed <- demos_wave_table_transposed %>%
  rename('Wave 1 (a)' = V1,
         'Wave 2 (b)' = V2,
         'Wave 3 (c)' = V3,)

demos_wave_table_transposed

align_spec <- c("l","r", "r", "r")

# Latex code
xtable(demos_wave_table_transposed, align = align_spec, booktabs = T)
```

# Correlation table

```{r, Descriptives and correlation table}

# Select only the needed variables from the df
vars <- c("selfPerp", "selfVict", "fear", "sexBin", "pgen_dc1", "pgen_dc2",
          "polSoc", "sess_dc1", "sess_dc2", "Age", "relPrac", "sexOrien_Bin") 

df_sub <- df_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(vars))

# Corr matrix
cor_mat <- as.data.frame(round(cor(df_sub, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"), 2)) 
cor_mat

##

# Format table for Latex

# Blank the upper triangle
cor_mat[upper.tri(cor_mat)] <- NA

# Function to compute correlation p-values
cor_pmat <- function(mat) {
  n <- ncol(mat)
  p.mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  colnames(p.mat) <- colnames(mat)
  rownames(p.mat) <- colnames(mat)
  for (i in 1:(n - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):n) {
      test <- cor.test(mat[, i], mat[, j], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
      p.mat[i, j] <- p.mat[j, i] <- test$p.value
    }
  }
  p.mat
}

# Get correlation and p-value matrices
cor_mat <- cor(df_sub, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
p_mat <- cor_pmat(df_sub)

# Blank upper triangle for p values
cor_mat[upper.tri(cor_mat)] <- NA
p_mat[upper.tri(p_mat)] <- NA

# Significance stars
get_stars <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "", 
         ifelse(p < 0.001, "***", 
         ifelse(p < 0.01, "**", 
         ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", ""))))
}

# Format correlations (round, remove leading 0s, add stars)
formatted_cor <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(cor_mat), ncol = ncol(cor_mat),
                        dimnames = dimnames(cor_mat))

for (i in 1:nrow(cor_mat)) {
  for (j in 1:ncol(cor_mat)) {
    val <- cor_mat[i, j]
    if (!is.na(val)) {
      stars <- get_stars(p_mat[i, j])
      val_fmt <- sprintf("%.2f", val)
      val_fmt <- sub("^-0\\.", "-.", val_fmt)   # remove leading 0 
      val_fmt <- sub("^0\\.", ".", val_fmt)     
      formatted_cor[i, j] <- paste0(val_fmt, stars)
    }
  }
}

# Add row names as a column
formatted_df <- as.data.frame(formatted_cor)
formatted_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(formatted_df, var = "Variable")

formatted_df

# Add means and SDs
formatted_df$Mean <- round(sapply(df_sub, mean, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
formatted_df$SD <- round(sapply(df_sub, sd, na.rm = TRUE), 2)

# Move mean and SD to front
formatted_df <- formatted_df %>%
  relocate(Mean, .after = Variable) %>%
  relocate(SD, .after = Mean)

formatted_df

# Rename variables (row)
formatted_df <- formatted_df %>%
  dplyr:: mutate(Variable = as.character(Variable)) %>%  # convert factor to character
  dplyr::mutate(Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable,
      selfPerp = "1. Perpetrator Blame",
      selfVict = "2. Victim Blame",
      fear = "3. Threat",
      sexBin = "4. Sex (Female = 0)",
      pgen_dc1 = "5. Moderate (vs. Liberal)",
      pgen_dc2 = "6. Conservative (vs. Liberal)",
      polSoc = "7. Social Ideology",
      sess_dc1 = "8. Wave 2 (vs. Wave 1)",
      sess_dc2 = "9. Wave 3 (vs. Wave 1)",
      Age = "10. Age",
      relPrac = "11. Religiosity",
      sexOrien_Bin = "12. Sexual Orientation (Straight = 0)",
  ))

formatted_df

# Rename variables (column)
formatted_df <- formatted_df %>%
  rename(
    '1.' = selfPerp,
    '2.' = selfVict,
    '3.' = fear,
    '4.' = sexBin,
    '5.' = pgen_dc1,
    '6.' = pgen_dc2,
    '7.' = polSoc,
    '8.' = sess_dc1,
    '9.' = sess_dc2,
    '10.' = Age,
    '11.' = relPrac,
    '12.' = sexOrien_Bin,
  )

formatted_df

align_spec <- c("l", "l", "c", "c", "S", "S", "S", "S", "S", "S", "S", "S", "S", "S", "S", "S")

descriptives_control_xtable <- xtable(formatted_df, align = align_spec, booktabs = T, include.rownames = FALSE, 
                          sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)
  
# Print appendix
print(descriptives_control_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)
```
